reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that integrates projects configured for several agent tools, preserving supported skills, commands, memory, hooks, permissions, and MCP settings across sessions.

summaries.zh: 将已配置 Claude Code、CodeBuddy Code、OpenCode、Codex、Pi、Gemini CLI 或 Cursor 的项目桥接到 DeepSeek Harness，并保留受支持的技能、命令、记忆及其他配置。
summaries.en: Bridges projects configured for Claude Code, CodeBuddy Code, OpenCode, Codex, Pi, Gemini CLI, or Cursor into DeepSeek Harness while preserving supported skills, commands, memory, and related configuration.

capabilities: Bridges configured agent tools into DeepSeek Harness
Discovers and exposes skills and commands
Bridges agent memory and hooks where supported
Bridges permissions and MCP configuration where supported
Supports web and headless CLI usage
